Track E outer edge is 127.6 and is not moved; playground perches X 128.3..128.6 and path X 128.6..129.8 stay clear. tt_trk_crossing is promoted but not co-located on the full straights (a second bed would clash); Rook may split straights and drop it in at ST+S1/S2 (X 57..64 / 86..92), ST+N1/N2, ST+E (Z 50..60.6), ST-AQS/AQN. WC interiors under the stands are temp-Services'; stand fronts stay lip-only so access stays open.
